content.scenario: A consumer, Rohan, purchases a fitness tracker based on an advertisement claiming it has a battery life of 2 years. However, the battery dies after 6 months. Rohan files a complaint with the consumer forum against the company for false advertising.
content.outcome: The consumer forum rules in favor of Rohan, directing the company to refund the purchase price and pay compensation for the misleading advertisement.
